specs.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / precise-object-edit. Create ONE polished square e-commerce hero photograph proposal from the supplied existing Gravuru native product preview. This is image A52-v1, the 50 x 20 mm rectangular BLACK glossy acrylic, 3 mm thick, with flush pale silver-white rear engraving sign. Physical front-face ratio EXACTLY 2.5:1. Corners are SQUARE (radius 0), straight clean edges. ONE plate, NO holes or fasteners.
Treat the reference front face as the fixed source: preserve its exact existing lettering, shapes, relative positions, typefaces, separators and black glossy material and restrained diagonal reflection. Do not redesign or redraw the artwork. Existing design TRE-V2A-5x2-D4. Visible text verbatim: "Familie / Hoffmann" (slashes here indicate existing separate placement/lines; do NOT add slash marks). Preserve the umlaut in Krüger if present. Preserve the complete house motif including door and four-pane window when present, and the complete lines/separators when present. No extra motif or text. Do NOT crop any part of the sign.
Change the presentation only: center the same single sign horizontally and vertically on a seamless clean white studio background, occupying about 88% of the square width. View nearly straight-on, front face parallel to image, only extremely slight perspective to suggest its true thin physical edge. Maintain the exact wide-to-short ratio above. Soft studio light from upper-left. One SOFT, diffuse, low-opacity contact shadow under/slightly right of the object to indicate depth; avoid a hard displaced silhouette, avoid a second stacked board, avoid an obvious thick rim or frame. The source's artificial heavy outline/drop silhouette should become a natural subtle material edge and soft shadow, while the actual front-surface material/engraving remains unchanged. Natural restrained product realism, crisp legible lettering, no raised lettering, no added gloss to stainless, no exaggerated texture, no acrylic-like material on steel. No props, no hands, no walls, no labels, no dimensions, no watermarks, no price badges. Square white-background product image only.
